name: Nebula Terminal
css:
/* Nebula Terminal: the observation window of a 1970s starship bridge looking out on a teal and magenta nebula (original illustration). Amber phosphor console panels with square corners, [ TX ] and [ RX ] channel tags, a fuel bar over the composer that drains as the context fills, and a scan line sweeping the header while the agent works. Dark only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 0;--t3-radius-bubble: 0;--t3-radius-card: 0;--t3-radius-control: 0;--t3-composer-outline: rgb(255 179 71 / 0.55);--nt-amber: #ffb347;--nt-dim: #b07a2e;--nt-teal: #4fd6c8;--nt-panel: rgb(8 10 14 / 0.88);--nt-mono: "SF Mono","Menlo","Monaco",ui-monospace,monospace}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{accent-color: var(--nt-amber);background: var(--t3-asset-art) 100% 50% / cover no-repeat,#05060a}[data-t3-part="main"]{--app-theme-canvas: transparent}[data-t3-part="sidebar"]{--app-theme-sidebar: transparent;background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(255 179 71 / 0.025) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px),linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(10 11 14 / 0.94),rgb(6 7 10 / 0.96));border-right: 1px solid rgb(255 179 71 / 0.35)}.sidebar-stage-backdrop{display: none}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span{color: var(--nt-amber)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span>span{font: 700 15px/1 var(--nt-mono);letter-spacing: 0.2em;text-transform: uppercase;color: var(--nt-amber);text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"]{background: rgb(255 179 71 / 0.06);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.4)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"] input{font-family: var(--nt-mono);font-size: 12px;color: var(--nt-amber)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"] input::placeholder{color: var(--nt-dim);opacity: 1}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button,[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"] svg{color: var(--nt-amber)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]{background: rgb(255 179 71 / 0.035);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.25)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]:hover{background: rgb(255 179 71 / 0.08)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-variant="card"] [data-t3-part="thread-body"]{height: auto;padding-block: 10px}[data-t3-part="thread-title"]{white-space: normal;overflow: visible;text-overflow: clip;font: 500 12.5px/1.4 var(--nt-mono);text-transform: uppercase;letter-spacing: 0.04em;color: #ffd9a0}[data-t3-part="project-name"]{font: 500 10.5px var(--nt-mono);letter-spacing: 0.12em;text-transform: uppercase;color: var(--nt-teal)}[data-t3-part="thread-status"],[data-t3-part="thread-meta"],[data-t3-part="thread-status"] *,[data-t3-part="thread-meta"] *{font-family: var(--nt-mono);color: var(--nt-dim)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"]{background: linear-gradient(90deg,var(--nt-amber) 0 4px,rgb(255 179 71 / 0.14) 4px);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--nt-amber),0 0 18px -4px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"] [data-t3-part="thread-title"]{color: #fff1d8;text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="working"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--nt-teal),0 0 16px -2px rgb(79 214 200 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="waiting"]{outline: 1px dashed var(--nt-amber);outline-offset: 2px}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="error"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ff5a4a}[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"],[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"] *{font-family: var(--nt-mono);text-transform: uppercase;letter-spacing: 0.14em;color: var(--nt-dim) !important}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]{position: relative;background: rgb(6 7 10 / 0.9);box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(255 179 71 / 0.4)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]::after{content: "";position: absolute;left: 0;bottom: 0;width: 18%;height: 2px;background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--nt-teal),transparent);opacity: 0;pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav li:last-child h2 span{font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--nt-mono);letter-spacing: 0.12em;text-transform: uppercase;color: var(--nt-amber);text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.5)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] button{color: var(--nt-amber)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"],[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){position: relative}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]::before,[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown)::before{position: absolute;top: 7px;left: 12px;font: 600 10px/1 var(--nt-mono);letter-spacing: 0.14em;white-space: pre;pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]{background: linear-gradient(rgb(255 179 71 / 0.12),rgb(255 179 71 / 0.12)),rgb(8 8 10 / 0.9);color: #ffe2b5;border: 0;padding-top: 26px;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--nt-amber),0 0 22px -8px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.6);font-family: var(--nt-mono);font-size: 13px;backdrop-filter: none}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]::before{content: "[ TX ]";color: var(--nt-amber)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background: var(--nt-panel);padding: 30px 22px 10px;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(79 214 200 / 0.45),0 18px 40px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9);color: #e6efe9}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown)::before{content: "[ RX ]";left: 22px;top: 11px;color: var(--nt-teal)}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"] :not(pre)>code{background: rgb(79 214 200 / 0.1);border-color: rgb(79 214 200 / 0.35);color: #8ff0e4}[data-t3-part="code-block"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.25)}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{position: relative;background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(255 179 71 / 0.03) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px),rgb(6 7 10 / 0.93);box-shadow: 0 0 26px -8px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.45),0 18px 40px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.9)}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{content: "";position: absolute;z-index: 21;top: -1px;left: 0;right: 0;height: 3px;background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--nt-amber) 0 14px,transparent 14px 17px);transform-origin: left;transform: scaleX(calc(1 - var(--t3-context-used,0)));box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.6);pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="composer-input"]{font-family: var(--nt-mono);font-size: 13.5px;color: #ffe2b5;caret-color: var(--nt-amber)}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[data-slot]{font-family: var(--nt-mono);font-size: 12px;text-transform: uppercase;letter-spacing: 0.06em;color: #ffd9a0}[data-t3-part="composer-context"]{background: rgb(6 7 10 / 0.9);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.3);font-family: var(--nt-mono)}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[aria-label="Submit message"]{background: var(--nt-amber);color: #120c02;box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgb(255 179 71 / 0.7)}[data-t3-part="right-panel"],[data-t3-part="terminal-drawer"]{border-color: rgb(255 179 71 / 0.4)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-content"],[data-t3-part="transcript"]{scrollbar-color: var(--nt-dim) transparent}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="chat-header"]::after{opacity: 1;animation: nt-scan 1.8s linear infinite}[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{animation: nt-blink 1s steps(2,jump-none) infinite}}@keyframes nt-scan{from{transform: translateX(0)}to{transform: translateX(455%)}}@keyframes nt-blink{50%{opacity: 0.5}}[data-t3-part="chat"] h1,[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ *{text-shadow: 0 0 3px #000,0 0 3px #000,0 0 12px #000,0 0 24px #000}[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ *,[data-t3-part="chat"] h1 ~ * *{color: #ffd9a0}
